_note: Ground pass v3. The carriageway is real geometry now with world-tiled UVs at 7.5m per tile, so the asphalt is seen at ~136 px/metre instead of the 3.5 px/metre it got when it was baked into the 2048px ground canvas. Detail in these tiles finally survives to the screen.
_seamless: The offset-and-crossfade seam fix in process_textures.py can only hide a seam inside noise, so every ground prompt forbids vignettes and hotspots - a large-scale gradient would still show as a visible tile edge.
_facades: Six more wall types plus two shopfronts, using the framing rules that worked in facades_v2 and city2.
